__doc: Floors of the heavy review (evals/heavy-recall), per case set and model, read by evals/investigation/gate.js through run-recall.js --targets. Same rules as the finder's (evals/investigation/targets.json): two runs of one commit, the per-PR run-to-run difference, recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma, collapse floors at about half the observed findings and tool calls, under the judge below.
Not calibrated yet: no model has a floor, so --gate exits 2 (not measured) until two runs per tier-0 model are written here.
